name: Heading
label: Heading
description: A heading whose outline level and type tier are chosen apart, with an optional link to itself.

props.name: level
props.description: The heading's place in the document outline, which sets the element (`h1` to `h6`). Choose it for the outline, never for the size.

props.name: tier
props.description: The type style it wears, apart from `level`, so a card's `h3` can look like a small title and a page's `h1` like a display line. Defaults to the level's own: heading-1 to heading-3 for levels 1 to 3, title-body below.

props.name: tone
props.description: The colour role: `default` takes the tier's own (the display or heading text colour a theme can tone), `neutral` the secondary text colour for a quieter title.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Keep the heading on one line, ending in an ellipsis where it runs out of room. The full text stays in the accessible name.

props.name: balance
props.description: Balance the lines of a heading that wraps, so the last line is never a lone word.

props.name: align
props.description: Where the text sits on the line, along the reading direction.

props.name: anchor
props.description:
Give the heading an id and a "#" link to itself, shown on hover and
focus, so a reader can link straight to the section. `true` makes the
id from the heading's text ("Getting started" becomes
`getting-started`); a string sets it. An `id` passed directly wins.

props.name: anchorLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the anchor link, given the heading's text. Defaults to "Link to <text>".

HeadingTier.description: A heading type style, named as the type scale names it, from the largest.

alternatives.name: SectionTitle
alternatives.when: the heading opens a page section, with a divider line or a count or action beside the title
